title: Quoted or named in Scripture
about: Verses of the Bible that quote or name another writing. Checked by hand: each entry says what the verse itself says, whether the writing survives, and where BibleChat has it. "Lost" means no copy of the writing is known.

items.note: Jude names Enoch, "the seventh from Adam", as the speaker. The same words stand in 1 Enoch 1:9 (Ethiopian Canon, R. H. Charles's translation of 1917). Read them side by side.
items.source: Jude 1:14-15; 1 Enoch 1:9 (R. H. Charles, The Book of Enoch, 1917)

items.note: The verse says the sun standing still "is written in the book of Jasher". An English "Book of Jasher" was printed in 1840 (in Get free Bibles); it tells the sun standing still in chapter 88. Scholars dispute whether it is the book named here.
David's lament over Saul and Jonathan "is written in the book of Jasher". The 1840 English Jasher (in Get free Bibles) is disputed as being this book.

items.writing: The book of the wars of the LORD
items.note: The verse quotes a line from it. No copy of the book is known.
Paul names the two men who withstood Moses. Exodus 7:11 tells of Pharaoh's magicians but gives no names. No writing about them is in BibleChat.

items.writing: Michael and the body of Moses
items.note: This dispute is not told anywhere in the Old Testament. No writing that tells it is in BibleChat.

items.writing: The book of the acts of Solomon
items.note: No copy of this book is known.

items.writing: The book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel
items.note: A court record of Israel's kings, named again and again in Kings. It is not the book of Chronicles in the Bible. No copy is known.

items.writing: The books of Samuel the seer, Nathan the prophet and Gad the seer
items.note: Named as the record of David's acts. No separate copies of these books are known.

items.writing: The prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and the visions of Iddo the seer
items.note: Named as the record of Solomon's acts. No copies are known.
Paul says he is quoting Greek poets: "For we are also his offspring." Their writings are not in BibleChat.
Paul quotes a Cretan writer without naming him. The writing is not in BibleChat.
